Bulgarian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈpari]

Noun

[edit]

па́ри • (pári)

  1. indefinite plural of па́ра (pára, “steam, vapor”)

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [pɐˈri]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ri
  • Syllabification(key): па‧ри

Noun

[edit]

пари́ • (parí)

  1. indefinite plural of пара́ (pará, “penny, cent, coin”)

Noun

[edit]

пари́ • (parí) pl

  1. money
    ня́мам ни́какви пари́ ― njámam níkakvi parí ― I don't have any money
Declension
[edit]
Declension of пари́
plural
indefinite пари́
parí
definite пари́те
paríte

References

[edit]
  • “пари”, in Речник на българския език [Dictionary of the Bulgarian Language] (in Bulgarian), Sofia: Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, 2014
  • “пари”, in Речник на българския език [Dictionary of the Bulgarian Language] (in Bulgarian), Chitanka, 2010

Macedonian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈpaɾi]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

пари • (pari) f pl (relational adjective паричен)

  1. money
Declension
[edit]
Declension of пари
plural
indefinite пари (pari)
definite unspecified парите (parite)
definite proximal париве (parive)
definite distal парине (parine)
vocative пари (pari)

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

пари • (pari) third-singular present, impf (perfective спари)

  1. (transitive) to breed, mate
  2. (transitive) to pair up

Etymology 3

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *pariti.

Verb

[edit]

пари • (pari) third-singular present, impf (perfective испари)

  1. (transitive) to steam

Russian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [pɐˈrʲi]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from French pari.

Noun

[edit]

пари́ • (parí) n inan (indeclinable)

  1. bet, wager (an agreement)
    Synonym: заклад (zaklad)

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

пари́ • (parí)

  1. second-person singular imperative imperfective of пари́ть (parítʹ)

Etymology 3

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

па́ри • (pári) m anim or m anim pl

  1. inflection of па́ря (párja):
    1. genitive singular
    2. nominative plural

Ukrainian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈpare]

Noun

[edit]

па́ри • (páry) f inan

  1. genitive singular of па́ра (pára)
  2. nominative/accusative/vocative plural of па́ра (pára)
